instruction: Start only after task 0007-hostile-product-audit completes successfully. Implement the next Folio north-star milestone around high-volume intake, mobile capture, connectors, and AI automation. Research current Cloudflare R2/Workers limits and design uploads around direct-to-R2 presigned uploads so browser/mobile intake is not constrained by Worker request-body limits. Support computer file picker, drag-and-drop, mobile camera capture, mobile photo library, PDF/image/office-file intake where supported, background batch progress, retries, deduplication, checksums, tenant-safe object keys, and clear user-facing batch/file/storage limits. Add a visible upload-capacity message in the UI based on configured product limits rather than infrastructure maximums. Target a practical professional default such as hundreds of receipt/document files per batch with resumable/background processing, but derive and document the final limits from performance tests and AI-processing constraints. Add an inbox/import workspace for email attachments. Implement or strengthen provider-neutral connectors for Gmail/Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 mail/calendar/OneDrive/Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Wave where public APIs support the required operations, using OAuth, least privilege, encrypted tokens, revocation, sync cursors/webhooks where available, tenant isolation, and audit trails. Build a Day at a Glance / Today experience that combines appointments, deadlines, client follow-ups, unresolved document requests, unread/actionable communications, exceptions, and prioritized next actions. Use AI to classify incoming documents, extract facts, propose client/file matching, summarize actionable email threads, draft follow-ups, detect missing evidence, and suggest next actions, but require professional confirmation for substantive tax/accounting decisions. Do not invent unsupported integrations or silently scrape private portals. Add tests, typecheck, full test suite, production build, Wrangler dry-run, and update product docs with exact upload limits and connector capabilities. Commit and push to main. Do not deploy production.
